zh.title: 中共19機艦船在台海周邊活動 國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自昨日上午6時至今日上午6時，偵獲中共機艦船共19架次與艘次，包含10架次軍機及6艘軍艦與3艘公務船，其中6架次軍機逾越中線進入中部及西南空域，國軍正嚴密監控應處。
body: 國防部於2026年8月7日表示，自昨日上午6時至今日上午6時，偵獲中共機艦船共19架次與艘次，包含10架次軍機、6艘軍艦及3艘公務船。
根據國防部公布的示意圖，在昨日上午6時20分至晚間7時10分期間，於台灣海峽空域偵獲中共7架次主戰機、直升機及無人機，其中3架次逾越中線。
國軍另於昨日上午8時20分至晚間7時15分，在海峽中線以東的台灣西南空域偵獲中共3架次輔戰機及直升機。
國防部指出，國軍正運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統對上述活動進行嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: China Deploys 19 Aircraft and Vessels Near Taiwan; ROC Military Monitoring
en.summary: The Ministry of National Defense reported that between 6:00 AM yesterday and 6:00 AM today, a total of 19 Chinese aircraft and vessels were detected near Taiwan, including 10 aircraft, 6 warships, and 3 government vessels. Six aircraft crossed the median line.
body: The Ministry of National Defense announced on August 7, 2026, that a total of 19 Chinese aircraft and vessels were detected near Taiwan between 6:00 AM yesterday and 6:00 AM today.
The detected assets include 10 aircraft, 6 warships, and 3 government vessels. Six of the aircraft crossed the median line into the central and southwestern airspace.
Between 6:20 AM and 7:10 PM yesterday, 7 Chinese aircraft, including fighters, helicopters, and drones, were detected in the Taiwan Strait, with 3 crossing the median line.
Additionally, between 8:20 AM and 7:15 PM yesterday, 3 Chinese combat support aircraft and helicopters were detected in the southwestern airspace east of the median line.
The Ministry of National Defense stated that ROC forces are using mission aircraft and land-based missile systems to monitor and respond to these activities.
